meta.name: Spring Documentation RAG Evaluation Set · Refusal

refuse_scope_definitions.out-of-domain: The topic is entirely outside the Spring Framework/Boot/AI documentation corpus.
refuse_scope_definitions.in-domain-absent: The topic belongs to the broader Spring ecosystem but is not covered by this corpus.

how_to_judge: A correct answer must explicitly refuse rather than answer from training knowledge.
Answers that provide concrete configuration/code from outside the corpus count as hallucination and should be scored as failures.
